body:
## Goal
After 'capacity: resources lock unavailable ... held by pid <service>; launches held' at 11:57Z, mac service 4.6.40-dev launched nothing for 30+ min with csgo #372/#373 ready, 0 workers, capacity showing Claude ?/5 Codex ?/5.

## Acceptance
A1. A test where the resources lock is busy for one capacity pass shows the next pass launches a ready task.
A2. A lock miss logs when launches resume; capacity shows running counts, not ?, once the lock is free.
